experimental_design: Finally, a comparative proteomic analysis with uEV from patients with bladder and renal cancer provided additional evidence of the selective enrichment of protein signatures in uEV reflecting their respective cancer tissues of origin.
factor_value: Mass spectrometry-based proteomic analysis of urinary EV (uEV) in men with benign and malignant prostate disease allowed us to significantly expand the known human uEV proteome with high specificity and identifies a unique biological profile in prostate cancer not uncovered by the analysis of soluble proteins.
number_of_technical_replicates: Three repeated runs per sample were performed.
technical_replicate: Three repeated runs per sample were performed.
technology_type: Samples were processed for LC-MS/MS by filter-aided sample preparation (FASP).
